  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The §26.H statement that a sync PR is “never by AI review” is inaccurate because a `workflow_dispatch` run with unavailable sync identity can fall through to Claude-fixer auto-merge.
  WHY: On `workflow_dispatch`, the `[skip ai]` marker fallback has empty PR title and body; if the sync exemption is denied, a clean Claude-fixer review can satisfy the auto-merge condition.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

- requirement: “Describe the narrowed skip accurately.” The documentation must describe that a `workflow_dispatch` run reviews the PR normally when identity lookup fails.
  expected_change_site: CLAUDE.md §26.H, lines 2117-2118
  confidence=[5]

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- CLAUDE.md:2117-2118 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: "A sync PR is merged by `claude-twin-sync.yml` or the repository owner, never by AI review" overstates the exemption. When a genuine sync PR's `GH_PAT` identity lookup fails during a `workflow_dispatch` run, the gate denies the twin-sync exemption (`sync_identity_unavailable` at review_autofix.yml:584-585). The `[skip ai]` marker fallback fails because `internal-review.yml:67-70` passes empty `pr_title` and `pr_body` on dispatch events (review_autofix.yml:621-623). The PR enters Claude-fixer mode; a clean review sets `CLAUDE_FIXER_ZERO_FINDINGS=true` (scripts/review_autofix_step_claude_fixer_handoff.sh:150); the auto-merge step at review_autofix.yml:5730 permits auto-merge when `CLAUDE_FIXER_MODE=true` and `CLAUDE_FIXER_ZERO_FINDINGS=true`; `scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh` has no suppressor for `claude/claude-twin-sync-*` heads (grep confirms only `^auto/forward-merge-stable-` and `^orchestrator/project-` are suppressed).
  WHY: This is a documentation defect with operational impact. CLAUDE.md ships to consumer repos and Claude sessions act on it as the contract. The absolute "never by AI review" tells session operators the gate cannot auto-merge a sync PR when the actual code can, in the dispatch + identity-unavailable fallback. The other updated docs in this PR — agents.md (lines 1264-1266) and changelog.d/5610-twin-sync-review-skip-provenance.md (line 5) — correctly scope the marker fallback to `pull_request` runs and document the `workflow_dispatch` normal-review outcome. CLAUDE.md alone keeps the unqualified absolute claim.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: PR description finding 1 — "CLAUDE.md:2113 — §26.H still says 'the gate and the sweep skip' any claude/claude-twin-sync-* PR... Fix: Says the sweep skips the head and the gate skips only a genuine sync PR... others are reviewed"
  Expected change site: CLAUDE.md §26.H, lines 2116-2118
  Evidence of absence: The diff at CLAUDE.md:2116-2118 correctly updates the first sentence ("the sweep skips that head, and the gate skips a genuine sync PR... any other PR with that name is reviewed, issue #5610"), but the immediately following sentence ("A sync PR is merged by `claude-twin-sync.yml` or the repository owner, never by AI review") retains the unqualified absolute claim that contradicts both the actual gate behavior in the dispatch + identity-unavailable fallback and the other two doc surfaces updated in this same PR (agents.md:1264-1266, changelog.d:5). The Copilot review comment (entry[0].id: 4152231527, CLAUDE.md:2118) explicitly flags this: "Limit 'never by AI review' to exempt/marker-skipped runs and document the dispatch fallback."
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- CLAUDE.md:2117-2118 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The §26.H sentence "A sync PR is merged by `claude-twin-sync.yml` or the repository owner, never by AI review." is overstated. The dispatch-fallback path lets a `claude/claude-twin-sync-*` PR reach `Enable auto-merge on PR` and complete an AI-driven auto-merge.
  WHY: When `gate_twin_sync_exempt` denies the exemption with `sync_identity_unavailable` (review_autofix.yml:584-585: `gate_pat_login` empty because `gh api user` failed), the gate falls through to the `[skip ai]` marker check at review_autofix.yml:621-623. `internal-review.yml:67-70` passes empty `pr_title` / `pr_body` on `workflow_dispatch` runs, so that fallback never matches. The PR enters the Claude-fixer path (review_autofix.yml:838-840 sets `CLAUDE_FIXER=true` for any `claude/*` head). On a zero-finding review the `Enable auto-merge on PR` step at review_autofix.yml:5712-5741 runs because its `if` at line 5730 allows `env.CLAUDE_FIXER_MODE == 'true' && env.CLAUDE_FIXER_ZERO_FINDINGS == 'true'`. `scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh` only suppresses `^auto/forward-merge-stable-` (line 215) and `^orchestrator/project-` (lines 249, 260) — there is no suppressor for `claude-twin-sync-*`, so the call lands. CLAUDE.md is the contract Claude sessions and consumers read; the other two docs this PR updates (agents.md:1264-1266 and changelog.d/5610-twin-sync-review-skip-provenance.md:7) both qualify the marker fallback to `pull_request` runs and describe the dispatch fallback correctly, so the §26.H tail is now the only doc surface that contradicts the actual gate behaviour. The PR's own added lesson ("A fail-closed fallback that relies on a PR-body marker such as [skip ai] only works on pull_request runs") names the exact gotcha and has not been applied to the §26.H sentence.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: PR description "describe the narrowed skip accurately" — the project branch must make CLAUDE.md §26.H match the actual gate behaviour on `workflow_dispatch` runs, so operators reading the contract document see the same dispatch fallback that agents.md:1264-1266 and the changelog fragment already describe.
  Expected change site: CLAUDE.md §26.H, lines 2117-2118 (the sentence "A sync PR is merged by `claude-twin-sync.yml` or the repository owner, never by AI review.")
  Evidence of absence: The PR edits the preceding sentence in CLAUDE.md:2114-2117 to qualify the skip to "a genuine sync PR (in coding-workflows, from a same-repository head, authored by the `GH_PAT` account; any other PR with that name is reviewed, issue #5610)" but leaves the absolute "never by AI review" tail at 2117-2118 unchanged. The agents.md and changelog updates added in this same PR explicitly document the dispatch fallback (a `workflow_dispatch` run "reviews it normally" / "passes no PR body to the gate, so it reviews the PR normally"), so the §26.H tail is now the lone surface that contradicts the other two updated docs and the actual gate path through the Claude-fixer auto-merge condition at review_autofix.yml:5730. The Copilot review comment on this PR (entry[0], id 4152231527, CLAUDE.md:2118) flags the same defect and asks the same fix.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: “Describe the narrowed skip accurately.” The PR also documents that when identity lookup fails, a `workflow_dispatch` run reviews the PR normally.
  Expected change site: `CLAUDE.md` §26.H, lines 2113-2118.
  Evidence of absence: The updated text limits the gate exemption to genuine sync PRs, but still says a sync PR is “never by AI review.” On `workflow_dispatch`, `internal-review.yml` passes empty PR title and body; if the identity lookup fails, `review_autofix.yml` denies the exemption and cannot use the `[skip ai]` marker. A clean Claude-fixer review can then satisfy the auto-merge condition at `review_autofix.yml:5730-5741`. The absolute statement remains inaccurate.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: PR description finding 1 states "CLAUDE.md:2113 — §26.H still says 'the gate and the sweep skip' any claude/claude-twin-sync-* PR... Fix: Says the sweep skips the head and the gate skips only a genuine sync PR (coding-workflows, same-repository head, GH_PAT author; any other PR with that name is reviewed, issue #5610)." The PR's own lesson at docs/implement-plan/issue-5610-limit-twin-sync-review-skip.md:42 states "A fail-closed fallback that relies on a PR-body marker such as [skip ai] only works on pull_request runs: workflow_dispatch callers pass no PR title or body to the review gate, so docs must not promise the fallback for every run." The agents.md update (line 1264-1266) and changelog fragment (line 7) both correctly qualify the marker fallback to pull_request runs and describe the dispatch fallback where the PR enters normal review.
  Expected change site: CLAUDE.md §26.H, line 2118 — the sentence "A sync PR is merged by claude-twin-sync.yml or the repository owner, never by AI review."
  Evidence of absence: The PR updates CLAUDE.md:2116-2117 to say "the sweep skips that head, and the gate skips a genuine sync PR... any other PR with that name is reviewed" but leaves the absolute "never by AI review" tail unchanged. When gate_twin_sync_exempt returns 1 at review_autofix.yml:584-585 (deny_reason=sync_identity_unavailable) on a workflow_dispatch run, the [skip ai] marker fallback at line 621-623 also fails because internal-review.yml:67-70 passes empty pr_title and pr_body on dispatch. The PR enters Claude-fixer review; a clean review with CLAUDE_FIXER_ZERO_FINDINGS=true satisfies the auto-merge condition at review_autofix.yml:5730 and invokes review_enable_auto_merge.sh:284, which has no suppression for claude/claude-twin-sync-* heads (only e2e-smoke-test, ^auto/forward-merge-stable-, and ^orchestrator/project- are suppressed). CLAUDE.md §26.H therefore incorrectly states AI review cannot enable auto-merge on a sync PR in this fallback path. The Copilot review comment (entry[0].id: 4152231527) explicitly flags this: "Limit 'never by AI review' to exempt/marker-skipped runs and document the dispatch fallback."
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
